A little, every day.

Read → hints → recall. Listen to each line, repeat it, then try without looking. After checking the answer, tell the app whether you remembered it.

Successful recall schedules another review in 1, 3, 7, then 14 days. A difficult verse comes back in today’s review. Progress stays in this browser, on this device.

Pronunciation: The audio is a synthetic Hindi reading of the original text, not a sung recitation. Awadhi pronunciations and spelling vary; use it as a guide, not an authoritative chant. “aa”, “ee”, and “oo” usually indicate longer vowels in the English-letter text.

The traditional text is by Tulsidas. Roman spelling has been simplified for practice. Text reference ↗

On iPhone, open the app in Safari. You can add a bookmark to your Home Screen using the Share menu. Audio needs an internet connection.
